   17 -- ===REGION Creating Potential Energy Grids
   18 -- | Creates a 3D potential energy grid from a function that says a given potential energy at a point in space
   19 createPotentialGrid :: (Length -> Length -> Length -> Energy) -> Int -> Length -> PhysicalGrid Energy
   20 createPotentialGrid = createGridFromFuncShifted
   21 
   22 -- | Finds the harmonic potential at a position given a spring constant
   23 harmonicPotential :: SpringConstant -> Length -> Length -> Length -> Energy
   24 harmonicPotential = harmonicFunc
   25 
   26 -- | Finds the sine potential at a position given an amplitude an scaling factor
   27 sinePotential :: Energy -> InverseLengthSq -> Length -> Length -> Length -> Energy
   28 sinePotential = sineFunc
   29 
   30 -- | A function to find the potential energy at a given point in a Gaussian well
   31 gaussianWellPotential :: Energy -> Length -> Length -> Length -> Length -> Energy
   32 gaussianWellPotential = gaussianWellFunc
   33 
   34 {-| Inside of a sphere of a given radius, sets 0 potential energy and outside of
   35 that sets an inputted other potential energy-}
   36 sphericalWellPotential :: Energy -> Length -> Length -> Length -> Length -> Energy
   37 sphericalWellPotential = sphericalWellFunc
   38 
   39 -- | Given a position as input, returns 0 energy
   40 zeroPotential :: Length -> Length -> Length -> Energy
   41 zeroPotential = zeroFunc
   42 
   43 -- | Given an electron density, this will find the potential energy for another electron to exist nearby
   44 coulombPotentialFromDensity :: Array Idx3 InverseLength -> Charge -> Charge -> PhysicalGrid Density -> PhysicalGrid Energy
   45 coulombPotentialFromDensity invTable q1 q2 (PhysicalGrid spacing grid) =

   46   PhysicalGrid spacing (listArray (bounds grid) [ potentialAt p | p <- allPoints ])

   47   where

   48     allPoints = range (bounds grid)

   49     amtOfParticleAtPoint :: Idx3 -> Double

   50     amtOfParticleAtPoint point = (grid ! point) |*| (spacing |*| spacing |*| spacing) # Number

   51     amtCache :: Vec

   52     amtCache = listArray (bounds grid) [ amtOfParticleAtPoint pt | pt <- allPoints ]

   53     sumInverseDists :: Idx3 -> InverseLength

   54     sumInverseDists p = foldl'

   55       (\ acc q -> if q == p then acc else acc |+| (amtCache ! q % Number) |*| invOffsetAt invTable p q)

   56       ((0 % Number) |/| (1 % Nanometer)) allPoints

   57     relCoulombConst :: EnergyDist

   58     relCoulombConst = q1 |*| q2 |/| (4 |*| pi |*| vacuumPermittivity)

   59     potentialAt :: Idx3 -> Energy

   60     potentialAt p = relCoulombConst |*| sumInverseDists p
   61 -- ===ENDREGION

   63 -- ===REGION Wave Solution Definitions
   64 -- | The solution for an electron cloud. This contains the eigen-energy of the particle, a probability density, and the spin of the particle if from a multi-particle solver
   65 newtype WaveSolution = WaveSolution (Energy, PhysicalGrid Density, Maybe Spin) deriving (Eq)
   66 {- | The wave function of an electron (psi). This contains the eigen-energy of the particle, a vector containning indexes and results of the
   67 wavefunction at various points in space, and the particles spin -}
   68 type WaveState = (Energy, Vec, Spin)
   69 
   70 instance Show WaveSolution where
   71   show :: WaveSolution -> String
   72   show = showWaveSolutionInUnit ElectronVolt
   73 
   74 -- | Shows a wavesolution in Energy units specified
   75 showWaveSolutionInUnit :: forall dim lcsu unit. (Energy ~ Qu dim lcsu Double, ValidDLU dim lcsu unit, Show unit) => unit -> WaveSolution -> String
   76 showWaveSolutionInUnit unit (WaveSolution (e, _, spin)) = case spin of

   77   Just s  -> show s ++ " " ++ printf "%.4f %s" (e # unit) (show unit)

   78   Nothing -> printf "%.4f %s" (e # unit) (show unit)
   79 
   80 instance Ord WaveSolution where
   81   compare = comparing (\(WaveSolution (e, _, _)) -> e)
   82 
   83 {-# INLINE waveToProb #-}
   84 -- | Given a wave function/result, convert it to a probabilty. (ie. psi -> |psi|^2)
   85 waveToProb :: Length -> Double -> Density
   86 waveToProb s = (|/| (s |*| s |*| s)) . (% Number) . (^2)
   87 -- ===ENDREGION
   88 
   89 -- ===REGION One State Solution Matrix Solving
   90 {- Given a potential energy 3D space, and any particle specific properties (like mass) this will return an energy
   91 matrix for solving for possible solutions to this system -}
   92 hamiltonianMatrix :: PhysicalGrid Energy -> [[Energy]]
   93 hamiltonianMatrix (PhysicalGrid s v) = [ [ f p q | q <- pts ] | p <- pts ]

   94   where

   95     pts = range ((0,0,0), snd $ bounds v)

   96     kineticCoeff = (0.0381 % ElectronVolt) |*| qSq (1 % Nanometer)

   97     k :: Energy

   98     k = kineticCoeff |/| qSq s

   99     f :: Idx3 -> Idx3 -> Energy

  100     f p q

  101       | p == q             = (6 |*| k) |+| (v ! p)

  102       | manhattan p q == 1 = (-1) |*| k

  103       | otherwise          = 0 % ElectronVolt
  104 
  105 {- Given a grid saying the potential energy in the system, and any particle specific properties (like mass) this will
  106 solve for possible eigen energies the particle can hold and also for probability densities of the particle at that given
  107 energy (the eigen vectors) -}
  108 solveAllOrbitals :: PhysicalGrid Energy -> [WaveSolution]
  109 solveAllOrbitals (PhysicalGrid s v) = sort (map WaveSolution (zip3 energies densityGrids (repeat Nothing)))

  110   where

  111     (energies, waveFuncs) = solveMatrix ElectronVolt (hamiltonianMatrix (PhysicalGrid s v))

  112     waveFuncGrids :: [Grid3D Double]

  113     waveFuncGrids = map (listArray (bounds v)) waveFuncs

  114     densitiesGrid3D :: [Grid3D Density]

  115     densitiesGrid3D = map (fmap $ waveToProb s) waveFuncGrids

  116     densityGrids :: [PhysicalGrid Density]

  117     densityGrids = map (PhysicalGrid s) densitiesGrid3D
  118 -- ===ENDREGION
  119 
  120 -- ===REGION One State Solution Vector Solving
  121 -- | Computes the hamiltonian given a potential energy grid. This is done using vector storage.
  122 hamiltonianVector :: forall dim lcsu unit. (Energy ~ Qu dim lcsu Double, ValidDLU dim lcsu unit)
  123   => unit -> PhysicalGrid Energy -> (Vec -> Vec, unit)
  124 hamiltonianVector unit (PhysicalGrid s v) = (matvec, unit)

  125   where

  126     matvec :: Vec -> Vec

  127     matvec psi = listArray (bounds v)

  128       [ (6 |*| k |*| (psi ! p % Number) |+| (v ! p |*| (psi ! p % Number)) |-| (k |*| (neighborSum psi p % Number))) # unit

  129       | p <- range $ bounds v ]

  130     kineticCoeff = (0.0381 % ElectronVolt) |*| qSq (1 % Nanometer)

  131     k :: Energy

  132     k = kineticCoeff |/| qSq s

  133     neighborSum :: Vec -> Idx3 -> Double

  134     neighborSum psi p = sum [ psi ! q | q <- neighborsOf p (snd $ bounds v) ]
  135 
  136 -- | Gets the lowest orbital solution in a 1 particle system using lanczos quick matrix calculations
  137 solveLowestOribtal :: PhysicalGrid Energy -> WaveSolution
  138 solveLowestOribtal grid@(PhysicalGrid s v) = WaveSolution (energy, densityGrid, Nothing)

  139   where

  140     (energy, waveFunc) = lanczosLowest (hamiltonianVector ElectronVolt grid) (snd (bounds v))

  141     waveFuncGrid  :: Grid3D Double

  142     waveFuncGrid = listArray (bounds v) (elems waveFunc)

  143     densityGrid3D :: Grid3D Density

  144     densityGrid3D = fmap (waveToProb s) waveFuncGrid

  145     densityGrid :: PhysicalGrid Density

  146     densityGrid = PhysicalGrid s densityGrid3D
  147 -- ===ENDREGION
  148 
  149 -- ===REGION Orthogonality Forcing
  150 -- | Generates every combination of spin up/spin down unique assignments for a given number of electrons
  151 candidateSpinAssignments :: Int -> [[Spin]]
  152 candidateSpinAssignments = binaryPartitions SpinUp SpinDown
  153 
  154 -- | The bare one-electron energy <psi|T+V_ext|psi> — kinetic + external potential only
  155 oneElectronEnergy :: PhysicalGrid Energy -> Vec -> Energy
  156 oneElectronEnergy extPotential psi = (dotA psi (h0 psi) / dotA psi psi) % ElectronVolt

  157   where

  158     h0 :: Vec -> Vec

  159     (h0, _) = hamiltonianVector ElectronVolt extPotential
  160 
  161 -- | Correct total Hartree-Fock energy: E = 1/2 * sum(h_i + epsilon_i)
  162 totalEnergyHF :: PhysicalGrid Energy -> [WaveState] -> Energy
  163 totalEnergyHF extPotential states =

  164   (0.5 % Number) |*| foldl1' (|+|)

  165     [ h_i |+| epsilon_i | (epsilon_i, psi, _) <- states, let h_i = oneElectronEnergy extPotential psi ]
  166 -- ===ENDREGION
  167 
  168 -- ===REGION Hartree Fock
  169 {-| Hartree-Fock exchange contribution. Given the orbitals of electrons already placed into the
  170 system, this is what gets subtracted from the plain Hamiltonian's action on a trial wavefunction. -}
  171 exchangeTerm :: Array Idx3 InverseLength -> Length -> [Vec] -> Vec -> Vec
  172 exchangeTerm _ _ [] psi = zeroVec psi

  173 exchangeTerm invTable _ previousOrbitals psi = foldl1' addA (map contributionFrom previousOrbitals)

  174   where

  175     pts = range (bounds psi)

  176     exchangeConst :: EnergyDist

  177     exchangeConst = electronCharge |*| electronCharge |/| (4 |*| pi |*| vacuumPermittivity)

  178     contributionFrom :: Vec -> Vec

  179     contributionFrom phi = listArray (bounds psi)

  180       [ (exchangeConst |*| overlapPotentialAt p |*| (phi ! p % Number)) # ElectronVolt | p <- pts ]

  181       where

  182         overlapPotentialAt :: Idx3 -> InverseLength

  183         overlapPotentialAt p = foldl'

  184           (\ acc q -> if q == p then acc else acc |+| ((phi ! q * psi ! q) % Number) |*| invOffsetAt invTable p q)

  185           ((0 % Number) |/| (1 % Nanometer)) pts
  186 
  187 {- | Builds a matrix-vector operator representing the Fock operator acting on a test wavefunction, by taking the
  188 plain single-particle Hamiltonian (kinetic + external potential) and subtracting the Hartree-Fock exchange contribution. -}
  189 hamiltonianVectorHF :: forall dim lcsu unit. (Energy ~ Qu dim lcsu Double, ValidDLU dim lcsu unit)
  190   => Array Idx3 InverseLength -> unit -> PhysicalGrid Energy -> [Vec] -> (Vec -> Vec, unit)
  191 hamiltonianVectorHF invTable unit grid previousOrbitals =

  192   let

  193     localMatvec :: Vec -> Vec

  194     (localMatvec, _) = hamiltonianVector unit grid

  195     fockMatvec :: Vec -> Vec

  196     fockMatvec psi = localMatvec psi `subA` exchangeTerm invTable (spacing grid) previousOrbitals psi

  197   in (fockMatvec, unit)
  198 
  199 -- | An pass on adjusting and finding new states when solving for a self consitent field of multiple electrons
  200 scfPass :: Array Idx3 InverseLength -> [WaveState] -> PhysicalGrid Energy -> [WaveState]
  201 scfPass invTable states extPotential = map resolve [0 .. length states - 1]

  202   where

  203     othersDensity :: Int -> PhysicalGrid Density

  204     othersDensity i = case [ mapVecToGrid extPotential psi waveToProb | (j, (_, psi, _)) <- zip [0 ..] states, j /= i ] of

  205       [] -> toZeroDensity extPotential

  206       densities -> foldl1' addGrids densities

  207     sameSpinOthers :: Int -> Spin -> [Vec]

  208     sameSpinOthers i mySpin =

  209       [ psi | (j, (_, psi, sp)) <- zip [0 ..] states, j /= i, sp == mySpin ]

  210     resolve :: Int -> WaveState

  211     resolve i =

  212       let

  213         mySpin :: Spin

  214         (_, _, mySpin) = states !! i

  215         repulsion :: PhysicalGrid Energy

  216         repulsion = coulombPotentialFromDensity invTable electronCharge electronCharge (othersDensity i)

  217         effectivePotential :: PhysicalGrid Energy

  218         effectivePotential = addGrids extPotential repulsion

  219         occupied :: [Vec]

  220         occupied = sameSpinOthers i mySpin

  221         energy :: Energy

  222         waveFunc :: Vec

  223         (energy, waveFunc) = lanczosLowestExcluding occupied

  224           (hamiltonianVectorHF invTable ElectronVolt effectivePotential occupied) (bndGrid extPotential)

  225       in (energy, waveFunc, mySpin)
  226 
  227 -- | An initial first greedy pass when doing a self-consitent field setup.
  228 greedyPass :: Array Idx3 InverseLength -> [Spin] -> PhysicalGrid Density -> [(Vec, Spin)] -> PhysicalGrid Energy -> [WaveState]
  229 greedyPass _ [] _ _ _ = []

  230 greedyPass invTable (mySpin : restSpins) cumulativeDensity previousElectrons extPotential =

  231   let 

  232     repulsion :: PhysicalGrid Energy

  233     repulsion = coulombPotentialFromDensity invTable electronCharge electronCharge cumulativeDensity

  234     effectivePotential :: PhysicalGrid Energy

  235     effectivePotential = addGrids extPotential repulsion

  236     sameSpinPrevious :: [Vec]

  237     sameSpinPrevious = [ psi | (psi, sp) <- previousElectrons, sp == mySpin ]

  238     energy :: Energy

  239     waveFunc :: Vec

  240     (energy, waveFunc)  = lanczosLowestExcluding sameSpinPrevious

  241       (hamiltonianVectorHF invTable  ElectronVolt effectivePotential sameSpinPrevious) (bndGrid extPotential)

  242     newCumulativeDensity :: PhysicalGrid Density

  243     newCumulativeDensity = addGrids cumulativeDensity (mapVecToGrid extPotential waveFunc waveToProb)

  244   in (energy, waveFunc, mySpin) : greedyPass invTable restSpins newCumulativeDensity (previousElectrons ++ [(waveFunc, mySpin)]) extPotential
  245 
  246 -- | Does a self consistent field calculation of repeated electron orbital position checking and potential energy generating on repeat
  247 runSCF :: Array Idx3 InverseLength -> Int -> PhysicalGrid Energy -> [Spin] -> [WaveState]
  248 runSCF invTable maxIterations extPotential spins = iterateSCF 0 initialStates

  249   where

  250     initialStates :: [WaveState]

  251     initialStates = greedyPass invTable spins (toZeroDensity extPotential) [] extPotential

  252     converged :: [WaveState] -> [WaveState] -> Bool

  253     converged old new = all (< 1.0e-6) (zipWith energyDiff old new)

  254       where

  255         energyDiff :: WaveState -> WaveState -> Double

  256         energyDiff (e1, _, _) (e2, _, _) = abs ((e1 |-| e2) # ElectronVolt)

  257     iterateSCF :: Int -> [WaveState] -> [WaveState]

  258     iterateSCF itersDone states

  259       | itersDone >= maxIterations = states

  260       | converged states next      = next

  261       | otherwise                  = iterateSCF (itersDone + 1) next

  262       where

  263         next :: [WaveState]

  264         next = scfPass invTable states extPotential
  265 
  266 -- | Finds hartree fock solutions for total energy and electron orbital solutions given a number of electrons, a max iteration, and a starting external potential
  267 solveInteractingElectronsHF :: Int -> Int -> PhysicalGrid Energy -> (Energy, [WaveSolution])
  268 solveInteractingElectronsHF numElectrons maxIterations extPotential =

  269   (totalEnergyHF extPotential bestStates, toSpinOrbitals bestStates)

  270   where

  271     n :: Int

  272     n = let (_, (iMax,_,_)) = bounds (samples extPotential) in iMax + 1

  273     invTable :: Array Idx3 InverseLength

  274     invTable = invOffsetTable n (spacing extPotential)

  275     candidates :: [[WaveState]]

  276     candidates = map (runSCF invTable maxIterations extPotential) (candidateSpinAssignments numElectrons) `using` parList rseq

  277     bestStates :: [WaveState]

  278     bestStates = minimumBy (comparing scoreOf) candidates

  279     scoreOf :: [WaveState] -> Double

  280     scoreOf states = sum [ e # ElectronVolt | (e, _, _) <- states ]

  281     toSpinOrbitals :: [WaveState] -> [WaveSolution]

  282     toSpinOrbitals states = [ WaveSolution (energy, mapVecToGrid extPotential psi waveToProb, Just sp) | (energy, psi, sp) <- states ]
  283 -- ===ENDREGION
